hero.bio: Websites, systems and automations that take the manual work out of small and mid-sized businesses. I'm co-founder and developer at The Souza Tech. At a trucking company, sending the proof-of-delivery photos went from hours to minutes.

about.title: About

photo.alt: Guilherme Campos, co-founder of The Souza Tech
photo.caption: // dev_guilherme · osasco, brazil

paragraphs: I started at CREA-SP, modernizing a large institutional system without breaking what already worked.

Later I spent a few days helping at my mother's trucking company (she's now my business partner) and built an app that cut the time to send proof-of-delivery photos from hours to minutes, with hundreds a day in peak season.
That project made me see automation as a service and led to The Souza Tech, where I handle the code, the deployment and the direct conversation with clients.

milestones.title: CREA-SP
milestones.description: Web development internship: incremental modernization of a system used across the state of São Paulo, integrated with legacy C# ASP.NET, internal APIs and DB2.

milestones.title: The photo app
milestones.description: Batch invoice lookup, OCR for the invoice number and batch upload through the API. Sending the photos went from hours to minutes.

milestones.title: The Souza Tech
milestones.description: Websites, automations and systems for small and mid-sized businesses. I handle the code, the deployment and the conversation with clients.

nfe.title: NF-e / CT-e Lookup
nfe.description: The team looked up invoices one by one and downloaded, renamed and sent every proof-of-delivery photo by hand. Now it's batch lookup, Excel export, OCR of the invoice number and batch upload through the API, shipped as an .exe.
nfe.result: Sending the photos went from hours to minutes; the team only reviews the exceptions.

billwise.title: BillWise Dashboard
billwise.description: Personal finance management with shared and isolated workspaces, role-based permissions, installments, budgets, analytics, cron-based recurrences, CSV/XLSX import and Turnstile.
billwise.result: In production and used by my family. 723 tests, TDD, CI on GitHub Actions and Git Flow.

souzaTech.title: The Souza Tech
souzaTech.description: Lead capture with a thank-you page, consent-based GA4, local SEO with structured data and 70+ tests. Git Flow with versioned releases.

souzaTransportes.title: The Souza Transportes
souzaTransportes.description: Scroll-driven animated story, respects prefers-reduced-motion, content visible without JavaScript, video that skips slow connections and WhatsApp quotes with a prefilled message.
souzaTransportes.result: A project for the Souza group, with AI-generated images.

frotaAgil.name: Frota Ágil Entregas
frotaAgil.challenge: Routes put together by hand in a spreadsheet every morning.
frotaAgil.result: 1h30 → 10 min to close the day's routes.

odontoLume.name: Odonto Lume
odontoLume.challenge: Bookings by phone only and lots of no-shows.
odontoLume.result: −35% no-shows with online booking and reminders.

emporioVilaNova.name: Empório Vila Nova
emporioVilaNova.challenge: Orders by voice message and no up-to-date price list.
emporioVilaNova.result: +18% average ticket with the WhatsApp catalog.

baseFirme.name: Base Firme Construções
baseFirme.challenge: Weekly site report assembled by hand.
baseFirme.result: 1 day → 20 min with a Python-generated PDF.
